infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Genie connects to your briefing server on your local network to research and build news briefings.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Genie transcribes your voice so you can ask questions about the news.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Genie uses the microphone so you can ask questions about the news by voice.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Genie doesn't access your photos. This is only shown if an embedded web page asks you to choose a photo.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Genie doesn't use your camera. This is only shown if an embedded web page asks to use it.
